task_description: Eliminate chapter progression paradox where accepted round v2 was overwritten by v1 due to timestamp collision, and allow sequential chapter uploads when preceding chapter is accepted/approved/locked.
root_causes: ProjectSubmissionsPage.jsx and ProposalCompilationPage.jsx reduced latest submissions using currentTs >= existingTs without comparing version numbers first. When an adviser accepted a round, bulk updatedAt timestamp update caused v1 to overwrite v2.

Server uploadChapter, compileProposal, and client ChapterUploadPage strictly gated chapter progression on status === SUBMISSION_STATUSES.LOCKED, rejecting submissions with status 'accepted' or 'approved'.
SubmissionDetailPage.jsx lacked version context, leaving users on older revisions without notifying them that a newer version was available.

modifications.change: Updated previousChapterLocked checks in uploadChapter and compileProposal to allow LOCKED, APPROVED, or ACCEPTED statuses.

Updated latestChapterSubmissions reduce logic to prioritize version number first before timestamp, and updated canUploadChapter to permit progression when previous chapter is locked, approved, or accepted.
Defined APPROVED_CHAPTER_STATUSES and allowed ACCEPTED/APPROVED/LOCKED statuses for candidate chapter selection and form validation.
Added SUBMISSION_STATUSES.ACCEPTED to chapterStatusBadge, chapterStatusIcon, and suggestedUploadChapter.
Updated getLatestChapterSubmissions to prioritize higher version numbers before timestamps.
Integrated useChapterHistory to display revision switcher pills (v1, v2) and a prominent outdated version alert banner linking directly to the latest revision.

verification.server_targeted_tests: Passed (should allow chapter 2 upload when chapter 1 is accepted)
verification.playwright_visual_audit: Passed (10 screenshots captured in desktop & mobile, dark & light)
